reason: Egg has pageview statistics but no endpoint for a combined deployment health and runtime summary, and no matching CLI command.

spec.summary: Show a deployment snapshot with age, pod and restart counts, resource use, request volume, errors, and latency.

reason: Egg's logs command can follow deployment build output, but it does not provide the filtered structured runtime log stream this command reads.

spec.summary: Read recent structured runtime entries for a deployment, with optional severity and text filters, and optionally keep emitting new entries.

args.name: deploymentId
args.description: Deployment whose runtime logs to read.

flags.name: level
flags.description: Keep entries at the selected severity.

flags.name: tail
flags.description: Maximum recent lines to scan; defaults to 200 and is capped at 20,000.

flags.name: follow
flags.description: Poll or subscribe for new entries until interrupted.

reason: Egg has this endpoint but it reports pageview counts rather than request errors and latency, and the CLI has no matching command.

spec.summary: Show a deployment's recent request rate, error rate, and average and maximum latency for the last hour.

args.name: deploymentId
args.description: Deployment whose HTTP traffic to summarize.

reason: Egg exposes client-error and resource anomaly summaries, but the CLI lacks this command and grouped deployment runtime errors with time-window trends.

spec.summary: List grouped deployment errors with counts, recent trends, last-seen times, and representative messages.

args.name: deploymentId
args.description: Deployment whose error groups to inspect.

flags.name: window
flags.description: Look-back duration; defaults to one hour and must be at least one minute.

reason: Egg has no endpoint or CLI command that identifies a deployment's detected language, framework, and version.

spec.summary: Show the detected runtime language, framework, version, confidence, and evidence source for a deployment.

reason: Egg has no endpoint or CLI command that reports which observability signals are available for a deployment.

spec.summary: Report whether logs, container and HTTP metrics, access logs, custom metrics, traces, and runtime details are available.

args.name: deploymentId
args.description: Deployment whose available signals to inspect.

reason: Egg's activity endpoint exists, but the CLI has no deployment-scoped feed command or its category and pagination filters.

spec.summary: List the newest audit, build, release, pod, and error entries for one deployment, with cursor-based paging.

flags.name: kinds
flags.description: Comma-separated activity categories; omit to include every category.

flags.name: cursor
flags.description: Continue from a cursor returned by an earlier page.

flags.name: all
flags.description: Fetch successive pages, up to the 100-page safety limit.

reason: Egg exposes a paged project changes feed, but has no CLI command or endpoint for organization-wide live event delivery and replay.

spec.summary: Continuously emit organization events, optionally filter by type, and resume after reconnecting from a supplied event identifier.

flags.name: types
flags.description: Comma-separated event types to include; omit to include all types.

flags.name: since-id
flags.description: Replay events newer than this identifier before switching to live delivery.
